We're building a direct, on-the-ground presence at key universities to speed up verification and establish a lasting relationship with each university's administration, rather than relying solely on third-party vendors.   About the Role   As a Campus Ambassador Consultant, you'll be our direct point of contact at your university. This is a daily, on-campus role: you'll need to be physically present at your university every day, both to submit and follow up on verification requests, and to build and maintain a working relationship with the university office. Candidates who already have connections within the university administration, or who can build them quickly, will be strongly preferred.  This is not a one-off task-based gig. You are the university's dedicated point of contact for SpringVerify.   What You'll Do     Be present on campus every day    Receive check details from us- student details, marksheet copies, and an authorisation letter    Submit verification requests at your university's office    Build and maintain a direct relationship with relevant university staff/departments to speed up processing    Follow up in person until each request is processed (university fees, where applicable, are paid directly by us-  you never spend your own money)    Collect the confirmation and send us proof of completion for each check    Respond to new requests promptly and reliably     Who We're Looking For     A current student at University of Mumbai, Osmania University (Hyderabad), or Bangalore University    Able to be on campus every day    Has existing connections within the university office/administration, or is confident about building them    Reliable, responsive, and comfortable following up until a task is closed out    Has a bank account and a phone    No prior work experience required     Compensation     ₹49 per completed check    Contract basis - you are paid per verified check, not a fixed monthly amount    Weekly payouts, disbursed upon receiving confirmation for completed checks    University fees, if any, are paid directly by SpringVerify — you never pay out of pocket     Time Commitment   Daily presence on campus required. Time per individual check is typically 30–60 minutes, but the role requires consistent, everyday availability - not just per-task engagement.
